intro.heading: Welcome to singing
intro.text: I am a voice teacher and music pedagogue based in Oulu, Finland, with over a decade of experience. I teach at Karjasilta, Oulu, under the cooperative Lilith. Student spots open up from time to time. Hobbyists and professionals of all levels and ages are welcome, regardless of musical genre.
intro.note: Note: Singing lessons can also help with performance anxiety and support people who use their voice professionally.
intro.quoteText: Music is the language of the soul.

cards.quote: I have found the joy of singing — and even performing. I call my lessons with Riikka 'singing therapy sessions.' After the lessons, I am without exception very energetic and empowered. Thank you, Riikka.
cards.author: Jarmo, 57

cards.quote: I went to a singing lesson. It had been about three years since the last time. But what an experience! Riikka Vuorijärvi got me to really breathe properly, and when I opened my mouth — things started happening. I recommend Riikka's singing lessons from the bottom of my heart.
cards.author: Woman, 36
